narrative: Iran's naval seizure of a US drone in the Strait of Hormuz elevates geopolitical friction over the weekend, setting up broad US dollar risk-premium demand for the Tokyo open. EUR/USD closed Friday at 1.1401, where a +144bp OIS carry disadvantage leaves it vulnerable to downside pressure. Meanwhile, AUD/USD closed Friday at 0.7026 and faces immediate headline headwinds alongside Monday's high-impact RBA rate decision, while USD/JPY closed at 157.19 with the greenback likely to find support.
